exposure: Extremely preterm birth (<28 weeks gestational age)
Very-moderate preterm birth (28-33 weeks gestational age)
Late preterm birth (34-36 weeks gestational age)
outcome: High school graduation (completion of 30 course credits in grades 9-12 without needing a modified (M) course or an individualized education plan (IEP) and finishing high school within 4 years of entering grade 9)
Need for a modified (M) course or an individualized education plan (IEP)
cohort: Adolescents born in Manitoba, Canada between 1986 and 2002 whose graduation data were available in administrative databases.
finding: Adolescents born extremely preterm and very-moderate preterm had significantly lower high school graduation rates compared to those born term, with the lowest rates observed in extremely preterm children.
followup_time: Up to high school graduation (typically around 18 years of age)
gest_age: <37 weeks (categorized as <28 weeks, 28-33 weeks, 34-36 weeks) and >=37 weeks (term)
